listingTitle: Keep secrets out of process arguments
title: Do not pass secrets through process arguments
why: Command arguments may be visible in process listings, diagnostics, audit records, and shell traces.
suggestion: Use a protected file descriptor, standard input, a permission-restricted file, or the tool's dedicated secret provider.
limitations: Detection is limited to explicit password, token, secret, and API-key option names with argument values; boolean options and conventional password-lock markers are excluded.
Whether a value is genuinely sensitive cannot be established statically.
